name: Kyte
description: Kyte is a non-custodial, fully collateralised options market on Robinhood Chain: covered calls and cash-secured puts on Robinhood stock tokens, Pons launchpad tokens and $KYTE, with fees split to stakers, buyback and burn, and a public proof page. Its MCP server reads live markets and prepares kyte.sh links that a person signs in their own wallet; it never signs, sends or sees a key.
